blocks.text: Exercises: sentences and translations from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Я хочу просто заползти в ___ (норка, acc. sg.) и умереть.
exercises.prompt: I just want to crawl into a hole and die.
exercises.why: **норка → норку** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like газета (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Мы здесь во ___ (имя, acc. sg.) Иисуса Христа и короля Карла.
exercises.prompt: We are here in the name of Jesus Christ and King Charles.
exercises.why: **имя → имя** (acc. sg.). Neuter, nominative singular in -мя. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. имя · имени · имени · имя · именем · имени; pl. имена · имён · именам · имена · именами · именах.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Кролик юркнул в свою ___ (нора, acc. sg.) и исчез.
exercises.prompt: The rabbit plunged into its burrow and disappeared.
exercises.why: **нора → нору** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like газета (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Она всадила ему нож в ___ (спина, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: She stabbed him in the back.
exercises.why: **спина → спину** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like газета (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Папа Тома сводил его в ___ (аквапарк, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Tom's dad took him to a waterpark.
exercises.why: **аквапарк → аквапарк** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

**киберпространство → киберпространство** (acc. sg.). Neuter. Declines like окно (A. sg. окно). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).
**секунда → секунду** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like газета (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.prompt: How much is the room charge?
exercises.why: **комната → комнату** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like газета (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: По дороге в ___ (аэропорт, acc. sg.) они остановились на заправочной станции.
exercises.prompt: On the way to the airport they stopped at a gas station.
exercises.why: **аэропорт → аэропорт** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Взломщик направил своё оружие на ___ (жертва, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: The burglar pointed his gun at the victim.
exercises.why: **жертва → жертву** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like газета (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Том был одет в ___ (форма, acc. sg.) уборщика.
exercises.prompt: Tom was wearing a janitor's uniform.
exercises.why: **форма → форму** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like газета (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Когда война закончилась, ему пришлось отправиться в ___ (изгнание, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: When the war ended, he had to go into exile.
exercises.why: **изгнание → изгнание** (acc. sg.). Neuter. Declines like здание (A. sg. здание). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

**понедельник → понедельник** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Я молчал в ___ (течение, acc. sg.) длительного времени.
exercises.prompt: I have been silent for a long time.
exercises.why: **течение → течение** (acc. sg.). Neuter. Declines like здание (A. sg. здание). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Выпьем за нашу очаровательную ___ (хозяйка, acc. sg.)!
exercises.prompt: Let's drink to our charming hostess!
exercises.why: **хозяйка → хозяйку** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like сестра (A. sg. сестру). Ending -а → -у.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Я выкладываю ___ (бабочка, acc. sg.) из страз.
exercises.prompt: I'm forming a butterfly from rhinestones.
exercises.why: **бабочка → бабочку** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like сестра (A. sg. сестру). Ending -а → -у.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Блаженны чистые сердцем, ибо они ___ (Бог, acc. sg.) узрят.
exercises.prompt: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.
exercises.why: **Бог → Бога** (acc. sg.). Masculine, animate. Declines like студент (A. sg. студента). Ending — (no ending) → -а.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).
